name: Scott AFB
description: Home of Air Mobility Command HQ and the 375th Airlift Wing — the Showcase Wing. Scott commands and controls all U.S. military airlift and air refueling.

currentNotifications.title: REAL ID Required for Base Access
currentNotifications.body: A REAL ID-compliant ID or U.S. passport required for base access. Non-compliant IDs require additional vetting — allow extra time.

primaryAction.title: In-Processing / Newcomers Page
primaryAction.address: 404 W Martin St, Scott AFB, IL 62225

sections.title: Required Documents
sections.body: Bring PCS orders, CAC, medical/dental records, marriage/birth certificates, and all travel receipts for finance settlement.

sections.title: In-Processing
sections.body: Check in with your unit and complete MPF in-processing within required timelines. AMC HQ is at Scott — coordinate with your specific directorate for additional reporting requirements.

sections.title: Housing
sections.body: Contact Housing at 618-256-5000 before arrival. Privatized family housing (Liberty Military Housing). Temporary lodging: Gateway Inn 618-256-6101. Dorm management: 618-256-5000.

sections.title: St. Louis Metro Area
sections.body: Scott is 25 miles east of St. Louis across the Mississippi River. Gateway Arch, Cardinals, and Blues nearby. Weather: cold winters with snow, hot humid summers.
